title: Peggy’s Cove Express Tour: Scenic Guided Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the charm of Peggy’s Cove on this 3.5-hour guided tour from Halifax. Journey through stunning Nova Scotia countryside before arriving at the picturesque fishing village known for its iconic lighthouse and rugged coastline. Spend an hour exploring at your own pace, taking in the breathtaking views and tranquil atmosphere. Enjoy bottled water throughout your tour to stay refreshed.

- Convenient pick-up in Halifax with eco-friendly transport
- Scenic 1-hour drive through picturesque landscapes
- 1-2 hours to explore the charming village and famous lighthouse
